title: Time reconstruction · 4,200 primary trials
description: Seven densities and three durations. Negative controls share event counts with physical draws and are not extra independent samples.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap interval of the mean; 2,000 bootstrap draws. SD is trial spread; SE is uncertainty in the mean. No familywise adjustment.
sampleUnit: 200 independent Poisson sprinklings per density/duration cell; controls use the same counts.
assumptions: Known density; uniform Poisson sampling in a flat 1+1D Minkowski diamond; c=1; interior chain counts only. Finite-density bias is not included in a mean CI.
selection: All source rows and scalar columns. Empty fields become null. Nested CSV cells remain JSON strings.

title: Time reconstruction · 8,000 follow-up trials
description: Separately seeded post hoc equal-count follow-up. The primary adverse contrast was retained; follow-up samples are not pooled with the primary study.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% percentile bootstrap interval of the mean; 5,000 bootstrap draws. SD is trial spread; SE is uncertainty in the mean. No familywise adjustment.
sampleUnit: 2,000 independent Poisson sprinklings per density/duration cell; controls use the same counts.
assumptions: Known density; uniform Poisson sampling in a flat 1+1D Minkowski diamond; c=1; interior chain counts only. Finite-density bias is not included in a mean CI.
selection: All source rows and scalar columns. Empty fields become null. Nested CSV cells remain JSON strings.

title: Dimension estimates and adversarial controls
description: All 30 archived family/dimension/count summaries, including undefined estimates and deterministic controls.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% whole-order percentile bootstrap intervals (2,000 resamples). Classification/rate Wilson columns are separate binomial intervals; deterministic controls have no binomial interval.
sampleUnit: 200 independent orders per stochastic cell; 1,800 primary orders, 900 separate calibration orders, 3,006 controls.
assumptions: Uniform fixed-count Minkowski diamonds for geometric samples; candidate dimensions 2,3,4; inversion bounded to [1,10]. An arbitrary control can match the pair fraction without geometry.
selection: All source rows and scalar columns. Empty fields become null. Nested CSV cells remain JSON strings.

title: Six detectors · hierarchical acceptance
description: All hierarchical summaries for six detectors and all three registered targets, including unsuccessful multistatistic search outputs.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% hierarchical bootstrap: resample fits, then whole orders within fits (2,000 draws). Only three fits; constant samples may give zero-width bands. Per-fit Wilson bounds govern advancement.
sampleUnit: Three independently calibrated fits × 200 independent test orders per stochastic cell. Search checkpoints are paired, not independent.
assumptions: Acceptance is compatibility with selected summaries of a calibrated flat-diamond law, not geometric embeddability. Rank-two overlap is a positive control; box geometry is a boundary sensitivity control.
selection: All 1,350 rows. Nested per-fit records are available in detector-rates and the exact source; all scalar fields retained.

title: Detector acceptance · per-fit Wilson intervals
description: All 4,050 per-fit results; independent calibration fits are kept separate.
uncertainty: Two-sided 95% Wilson intervals conditional on each fitted detector and development pool. These are not simultaneous confidence bands. Deterministic endpoints have null bounds.
sampleUnit: 200 final orders per stochastic fit/cell; n is sample size, count is number of events in an order.
assumptions: Frozen templates/thresholds; nominal acceptance target differs from achieved test acceptance. Missing bounds are unavailable, not zeros.
selection: All source rows and scalar columns. Empty fields become null. Nested CSV cells remain JSON strings.

title: Registered advancement decisions
description: All designated benchmark cells. Every detector fails the full advancement benchmark; a supported cell alone is insufficient.
uncertainty: Decisions use an intersection of per-fit pointwise Wilson conditions; no simultaneous 95% claim.
sampleUnit: 66 designated cells per detector across all three independent fits.
assumptions: Positive lower bound ≥90%, negative upper bound ≤5%, every exact negative rejected; all conditions required.
selection: Flatten primary[detector].cells; preserve every designated cell and status.

title: Global observables across sampling regions
description: All global summary outcomes from diamonds, slabs, boxes and synthetic controls. Global dimensions depend on region shape.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% hierarchical whole-parent bootstrap across three fits. Inversions average only defined per-parent values; undefined counts retained.
sampleUnit: Ordinary cells have 600 parents: 200 per fit. defined and undefined expose metric support.
assumptions: Global diamond formulas require the diamond sampling law. A flat slab or box has geometry despite a shifted global estimate.
selection: All 525 rows; nested fit means omitted, existing ci95 split into ci_low/high without rounding.

title: All 42 primary conditional-law checks
description: All 42 primary checks meet their finite practical margins. Secondary failures, inconclusive tests and insufficient support are preserved. TV is a nonnegative distance, not a signed difference.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% hierarchical percentile intervals, resampling parents and independent references; 2,000 draws. TV bootstrap bias near zero can put the interval above its point estimate; this does not establish a positive distance floor.
sampleUnit: Three fits; 200 parents per ordinary fit. Intervals within a parent are dependent. Ratios pool counts within each fit and then average fits equally.
assumptions: Conditional diamond law assumes uniform sampling in a causally convex flat region. Boxes may clip intervals. Support requires ≥30 positive parents and ≥100 intervals in every fit.
selection: Across-fits N=256 diamond/slab rows, generating dimension equals reference dimension, seven registered observables; exactly 42 rows. Existing interval fields are copied exactly; ci_low/high split ci95. Nested diagnostics omitted.

title: Local conditional laws · all aggregate outcomes
description: All 42 primary checks meet their finite practical margins. Secondary failures, inconclusive tests and insufficient support are preserved. TV is a nonnegative distance, not a signed difference.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% hierarchical percentile intervals, resampling parents and independent references; 2,000 draws. TV bootstrap bias near zero can put the interval above its point estimate; this does not establish a positive distance floor.
sampleUnit: Three fits; 200 parents per ordinary fit. Intervals within a parent are dependent. Ratios pool counts within each fit and then average fits equally.
assumptions: Conditional diamond law assumes uniform sampling in a causally convex flat region. Boxes may clip intervals. Support requires ≥30 positive parents and ≥100 intervals in every fit.
selection: All across_fits rows (including 16 motif categories); within-fit diagnostics and nested support remain available in the exact source. Existing interval fields are copied exactly; ci_low/high split ci95. Nested diagnostics omitted.

title: Global versus local dimension reconstruction
description: Compare equal-fit means of per-parent global inversions with inversion of the pooled conditional two-event probability. These are different nonlinear estimands.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% archived intervals. Missing local dimensions remain null; no endpoint clipping or invented uncertainty.
sampleUnit: 600 parents per ordinary cell; sparse support can leave a local estimate undefined.
assumptions: Diamond/slab geometric cells recover known dimensions locally. Controls report reference-equivalent numbers, not physical dimensions.
selection: Unique family/dimension/count local_dimension from summary.json, plus global_dimension rows transcribed from global.csv. Both source hashes are recorded in provenance.

title: Growth and reference ensemble trajectories
description: All prefix and thinning ensemble results; six registered p values and five reference/control families. Layout coordinates are never physical space.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% within-batch whole-history bootstrap; 2,000 draws. Three batch means receive equal weight, without outer batch resampling. These bands do not replace the registered simultaneous decision bands.
sampleUnit: 96 independent histories per family: 32 per batch. Prefixes and four thinnings share a history; thinnings are averaged before resampling.
assumptions: Fixed p transitive percolation with ancestral closure. References are supplied sampling laws. E[t22]=1/24 is a d=2 diamond reference only, not a reference for other metrics.
selection: All 2,200 rows; nested support and batch means omitted, original ci95 retained and split exactly.

title: Registered simultaneous finite-signature screen
description: 48 growth entries plus two separately screened eight-entry controls. Every fixed-p family fails; the d2 reference and deliberately misleading height-two control both pass.
uncertainty: Registered simultaneous max-centered-error bootstrap bands across 48 growth entries, with separate zero-event safeguards. Coverage is approximate. Pointwise bounds are separate columns. Controls have their own eight-entry bands.
sampleUnit: 96 independent histories per family; repeated prefixes and thinnings retain their common history bootstrap weights.
assumptions: Each family must meet all eight ±0.005 practical margins: three late levels minus 1/24, two drifts and three thinning-prefix contrasts. Passing does not certify geometry.
selection: All 64 rows. band_low/high split band; pointwise_low/high split pointwise_ci95. No bands clipped to a physical probability range.

title: Growth local-law comparisons and missing support
description: All equal-batch conditional outcomes, preserving false rejections of genuine controls, insufficient information and reference disagreements.
uncertainty: Pointwise 95% history bootstrap with independent reference uncertainty. Near-zero TV percentile bootstrap is biased; it can exclude the point estimate. Not simultaneous bands.
sampleUnit: 96 histories per family. Conditional ratios pool counts within a batch; batch estimates are averaged equally. Interval counts are not independent sample sizes.
assumptions: At least 30 positive histories and 100 mean interval exposures per batch. The matched height-two control has no nonempty intervals: missing is not agreement.
selection: All equal_batch_mean rows; within-batch diagnostics and nested support remain in source. All scalar outcomes and original intervals retained; ci_low/high split ci95.
